questions.q: What problem does Oracle Fusion's Subledger Accounting (SLA) engine solve?
options: It stores subledger data so the General Ledger does not need a database
It replaces hardcoded, module-specific journal-building logic with one shared, configurable rules engine
It eliminates the need for a Chart of Accounts
It only exists to speed up report printing
questions.explain: Instead of each subledger coding its own posting logic, every subledger raises an event and hands it to one shared engine that applies configurable rules.

questions.q: In the Fusion architecture, how does a subledger application like Payables produce a journal entry?
options: It writes directly to the General Ledger tables
It has its own independent journal-building code, unrelated to other subledgers
It raises a business event and Subledger Accounting builds the journal entry from rules
A human must manually type every journal entry
questions.explain: Subledger applications record business events; Subledger Accounting is the shared engine that turns those events into journal entries.

questions.q: Why is it useful that Payables, Receivables, and Fixed Assets all use the same Subledger Accounting engine?
options: It isn't useful; each module actually uses a different engine
A consultant who learns how SLA works can read and troubleshoot accounting across every subledger that uses it
It means all subledgers must use identical accounts with no differences allowed
It removes the need for a General Ledger entirely
questions.explain: Because the rules engine is shared, the skills a consultant learns for one subledger transfer directly to every other SLA-enabled subledger.

questions.q: In the transaction flow described in this lesson, what happens immediately after a subledger raises an accounting event?
options: The event is deleted
The General Ledger posts it automatically with no rules applied
Subledger Accounting applies rules and produces a subledger journal entry
The transaction is sent directly to a bank
questions.explain: Subledger Accounting intercepts the event and applies configurable rules to build a complete, balanced journal entry.

questions.q: According to this lesson, how does the General Ledger receive journal entries from subledgers like Payables and Receivables?
options: GL queries the subledger tables directly every night
Every subledger entry passes through Subledger Accounting first; GL never talks to subledgers directly
Subledgers email journal entries to the GL team
GL generates its own numbers independent of subledger activity
questions.explain: Subledger Accounting is the only path between a subledger and the General Ledger — GL receives finished journals from SLA, never directly from a subledger.
